name: The Prophet Muhammad
overview: Scripture clearly defines the role and authority of a true prophet as one who speaks only the words commanded by God, warning that any who presume to speak in God's name without His command or who speak for other gods shall face death (Deuteronomy 18:20). The Bible also emphasizes the purity required in worship practices, such as building altars without hewn stone to avoid pollution (Exodus 20:25). The account of John the Baptist's interrogation (John 1:19) highlights the importance of recognizing true messengers sent by God. Additionally, Isaiah 29:12 illustrates the challenge of receiving God's word by those who are unlearned, underscoring the necessity of divine instruction and authority in prophetic revelation.
